# ARKA Constructions

> ARKA Constructions is a construction company based in Chengalpattu, Tamil Nadu, serving Chennai and surrounding areas with residential, commercial, industrial and civil construction services.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://arkaconstruction.in/): Company overview, approach, services, projects, packages and contact details.
- [Services](https://arkaconstruction.in/services/): Residential, commercial and industrial construction, civil works, fabrication, flooring, plumbing and infrastructure services.
- [Projects](https://arkaconstruction.in/projects/): Completed and ongoing construction work.
- [Packages](https://arkaconstruction.in/packages/): Construction package options and inclusions.
